keys.notes: Actively updated; 43+ models as of Apr 2026. Gold standard for agentic coding. Also tracked at epoch.ai, llm-stats.com, swe-rebench.com. SWE-bench-Live variant also active.
Actively updated; 22+ models Apr 2026. Old edit-format leaderboard replaced by polyglot leaderboard. GPT-5 (high) at 88%, Claude Opus 4.5 at 89.4%.
Still tracked (75+ models, avg 89.7%) but saturated — frontier models 95-97%+. Scores compress; limited signal at top. EvalPlus (HumanEval+) more rigorous. BigCodeBench is the recommended successor.
Papers with Code shut down Jul 2025. MBPP+ (EvalPlus) actively tracked. Base MBPP saturating for frontier models. CodeSOTA and llm-stats.com maintain active trackers.
Highly active; continuously adds fresh contest problems (LeetCode/AtCoder/Codeforces). Release v6 covers to Apr 2025; 71+ models tracked. Best contamination-free coding signal available.
ICLR 2025 paper; Hugging Face leaderboard updated ~Apr 2026. 1140 tasks, 139 libraries. BigCodeBench-Hard subset added Jul 2024. Email-submission model slows additions but tracker is live.
New benchmark; paper submitted Dec 2025. 6 models evaluated as of Apr 24 2026. Excluded from weighted scoring on BenchLM but displayed for reference. Repo-level generation benchmark.
Active; evolved to tau2-bench (telecom domain, Dec-POMDP). 30 models on tau2 leaderboard. Voice full-duplex added. Original tau-bench still referenced; taubench.com is canonical.
Actively updated monthly with fresh questions from arXiv, news, IMDb. 18 tasks across 6 categories. Latest release 2025-04-25. ICLR 2025 Spotlight. Strong contamination-free general benchmark.
Saturated for frontier models (88-93%+). Tracked but no longer differentiates top models. MMLU-Pro is the active successor. Still useful for smaller/mid-tier model evaluation.
263 models tracked; top models 91-94%. Approaching saturation at frontier but still best expert-science discriminator. PhD baseline is 69.7%. Tracked by Artificial Analysis and Epoch AI.

MATH-500 nearly saturated (97-99% frontier). Retained on some leaderboards for reference but not primary signal. AIME 2025/2026 and BRUMO now preferred. FrontierMath (Epoch AI) is emerging harder alternative.
AIME 2025 saturated (98%+ top-5). AIME 2026 now the active version (12 models, Kimi K2.6 leads at 96.4%). MathArena tracks live competition results. Yearly refresh avoids contamination.
10 models tracked; still cited in 2025-2026 but no active official leaderboard updates. GitHub repo (microsoft/AGIEval) not receiving new submissions. Referenced as baseline rather than primary eval.
116 models tracked but saturating (frontier ~94%). BIG-Bench Extra Hard (BBEH) released Feb 2025 as successor — frontier models avg only 9.8% on BBEH. BBH still reported but no longer primary signal.

Official test leaderboard submissions closed Nov 2024. Saturated at 95%+ for frontier models. Validity issues: 36% errors in validation set, 40% ungrammatical prompts. Stale for all practical purposes.
17 models tracked, all self-reported. Stanford HELM leaderboard deprecated. Not widely used for frontier comparisons. Phi-3.5-MoE leads at 77.5%. Still cited for truthfulness/hallucination analysis.
Dropped from HuggingFace Open LLM Leaderboard V2 due to saturation and contamination concerns. 21 models tracked, all self-reported, no 2025-2026 verified entries. Community moved to V2 benchmarks.

ARC Challenge (science QA) has GPT-5 at 96.3% — approaching saturation. ARC-AGI-2/3 (abstract reasoning) is the live successor with active 2026 competition. The science-QA 'arc' key is nearly saturated.
Papers with Code (primary tracker) shut down Jul 2025. 29 models on llm-stats.com but minimal 2026 activity. Removed from HuggingFace Open LLM Leaderboard V2. Effectively stale.

Completely saturated for frontier models (GPT-5.3 at 99%). 47-53 models tracked. Still useful for smaller/fine-tuned models. Contamination concerns documented (13% score inflation). AIME 2025/2026 replaced it as math signal.

The key 'humanevallp' likely refers to HumanEval language pack / MultiPL-E or mHumanEval. MultiPL-E tracks only 3 models on llm-stats. Superseded by BigCodeBench and LiveCodeBench for multilingual coding eval.

Static 80-question benchmark. At 95% CI, agreement with human preference drops to 22.6%. Replaced by Arena-Hard (500 curated questions, 98.6% human preference correlation, 3x better model separation).
Highly active; rebranded from LMSYS Chatbot Arena to 'Arena' (Arena Intelligence Inc.) Jan 2026. 323 models, 5.4M+ votes. Separate coding leaderboard. Claude Opus 4.6 leads at 1504 Elo.
Last GitHub activity Jan 2023. Submission via email (codexglue@microsoft.com) with no 2025-2026 entries found. Community shifted to SWE-bench, LiveCodeBench, BigCodeBench. Effectively dead.
